primary.unit: All18fixed cases, not just eligible successful ones
primary.support: All18have nonempty complete sources,eligible row/column inference,exhaustive source certificates,oneunique minimum,andzero false/missed N+1attack pairs.
primary.falsify: Any empty source,ineligible row/column inference,no source cover,ambiguous minimum,or unique minimum with any false/missed target pair falsifies the universal claim. Still finish/report everycase.
primary.incomplete: A timeout or failed validation remains incomplete and is never dropped. If no completed case falsifies but at least one is incomplete,the overall decision is inconclusive; an observed falsification remains a falsification even if other cases are incomplete.

limits: Supplied closed-world completeness and D4/minimum-description priors are stronger information than positive examples alone.
Uniqueness concerns only this finite candidate class; completeness need not identify one rule set without the minimum-description prior.
Eighteen fixed synthetic cases are a structural stress test,not independent random draws from a rule-family population.
No GPUsearch or optimizer fitting is performed. Structural exactness is separate from search performance and paper reproduction.
All target comparisons follow the global source seal; ambiguous source minima remain ambiguous even if only one transfers.
